newly_discovered_claims: Concentration can be affected ... before one [an alert] arrives, when the phone is close by. / A second study in 2023 looked at the quiet time before any alert.

results.original_ng_sentence: But concentration can be affected at two different times: when an alert arrives, and before one arrives, when the phone is close by.
results.issue: F-007が保証するのは、通知を受信せずスマートフォンの電源も切った条件で、端末が机上にある場合と別室にある場合を比較したこと。将来アラートが到来する前の時間を測定した研究だとする時間的・対象範囲上の再構成は、Ledgerの保証範囲を超える。
results.explanation: 「通知がなかった条件」を「通知が来る前の時間」へ置き換え、研究が検証した時間的状況を拡張している。

attempts.text: But concentration can be affected in two different contexts: when an alert is presented, and when the phone is nearby even when no notifications are received.

results.final_text: But concentration can be affected in two different contexts: when an alert is presented, and when the phone is nearby even when no notifications are received.
